# ProScada

> High-assurance SCADA Designer and Runtime built with Tauri v2, Rust, Svelte 5 and Modbus TCP.

## Start here

- [Repository agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Documentation index](docs/README.md)
- [AI work guide](docs/ai/README.md)
- [Skills catalog](.github/skills/README.md)
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/overview.md)
- [Toolbox 45/45](docs/toolbox/README.md)

## Critical invariants

- Designer never writes process values.
- Backend checks Runtime, role, writable and Good quality.
- Holding-register bits are 0..15, bit 0 is LSB.
- Prefer FC22; RMW requires single-writer ownership.
- UI transport feedback is not process confirmation.
- Alarm state belongs to the Rust engine.
- PLC retains watchdog, interlock and safety logic.

## Validation

`npm run check && npm run validate:widgets && npm run validate:docs && npm run validate:ai && npm run build`

`cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
